symptom: A Timeline enumeration the widget hides, set to a non-default value — `customVisualization: true, groupByDayOptions: 'dayMonth'`, or `groupByKey: 'day', groupByMonthOptions: 'monthYear'` — passes `mxcli check` and `exec`, and mx check reports "[CE0463] The definition of this widget has changed" at Timeline 'tlD' / 'tlG'. `mxcli widget describe timeline` says "2 of 6 editor hide-rules recognized"; `groupEvents: false` plus a hidden value was already an MDL-WIDGET10 error (ako/mxcli#1762, mendixlabs/mxcli#1668)
cause: Two editorConfig shapes went unread. terser folds the statements before a `switch` into its head — `switch(e.customVisualization ? hide([…]) : hide([…]), e.groupEvents || hide([…]), e.groupByKey)` — so the THEN branch's guard is bounded by the `switch(` paren, which parseGuard rejected as a conditional group (the else branch was lifted, through trailingExpr). And a hide in a `case`/`default` arm had no reading at all: its `case "day":` colon reached the ternary-else path and found no `?`. The template warnings the reporter saw in custom mode came from the hand-written fallback table in widget_defs.go, which listed only the TextTemplate keys of that same hide, on the stated premise that enumerations cannot cause CE0463
file: mdl/executor/editorconfig_switch.go (switchArmCondition, switchArms, statementHeadParen, atFunctionStatementLevel), editorconfig_extract.go (the switch-arm branch before parseGuard; parseGuard's `(` boundary), validate_widgets.go (visibilityCondWord in/notin), widget_engine.go (WidgetDefGeneratorVersion 20)
insight: **A known rule elsewhere is not the extractor knowing it.** The custom-mode warning made rule (1) look recognised, and it was the reason to ask why the enumerations in the same list were missed: `widget describe` (extractor only) showed no `title` rule, while the generated .def.json had one, merged from the hand table. Compare the two sources first when a rule half-works. **The reporter's framing (`the true branch of a ternary`) was not the cause**: the existing TimelinePattern test already lifted a statement-level THEN branch, and only the minified file showed that terser had moved it into the `switch(` head. Read the shipped JS, not the de-minified source. **Measure the matrix, then make it the oracle**: one widget per variant through `mx check --no-update-widgets` on 11.13.0 gave 6 CE0463 and 3 clean, and the extractor test, the check test and the bug-test all encode those nine. **Policy follows the existing split, not a second one**: hidden + non-default is refused (MDL-WIDGET10 error, exec preflight) and hidden + left out is written at the default, as rule (3) and the column-SET reset (mendixlabs/mxcli#1519) already do. **Bound the blast radius by dumping lifted rules for every installed .mpk before and after**: only Timeline and HeatMap changed. HeatMap folds into an `if(` head the same way, and its new rule is correct. **The scratchpad can be shared between agents**: work in a private subdirectory
